Overview

Relics are a longterm upgrade path in War Of Genesis progressed via dismantling and combining various pieces of loot from numerous grades. In this guide we'll break down the different types, what they do, and how to obtain the materials needed to increase them.




How To Upgrade Relics

In order to upgrade each Relic Type, you'll need to either combine or dismantle items of T3 - T6 Grade loot. Doing so will reward you with a small amount of crafting materials, which can then be exchanged to enhance the Relic type tied to that grade of item.

The loot needed can either be found randomly in higher difficulty content, or alternatively can be crafted up to by combining lower rarity items found when starting in Normal - Very Hard levels.

It's important to note that there are numerous Relic types depending on the gear combined/dismantled, ranging from weapons/armor to other equippables like wings
